# Introduction

Figure S13B: LOESS smoothing of Sex and treatment impact on PET/CT lung lesions.
Figure S13D: LOESS smoothing of Previous TB history and treatment impact on PET/CT lung lesions.
Figure S13E: LOESS smoothing of Mtb lineage and treatment impact on PET/CT lung lesions.

Each LOESS plot is annotated with p-values from a linear mixed-effects model of the form
outcome ~ Visit * group + (1|ID1), where Visit is treated as numeric (weeks: 0, 4, 16, 24).
The LME provides a formal statistical test of the linear group × time interaction alongside
the non-parametric visual trend from LOESS.

# Load packages

```{r}
#| label: load-packages
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(lme4)
library(car)
library(writexl)
```

# Define file paths

```{r}
#| label: file-paths

input_file  <- "Input/Demographic and clinical information.xlsx"
input_pet   <- "Input/PET.CT_long_SATVI.xlsx"
output_main <- "Output/Figure_S13B_S13D_S13E"

dir.create(output_main, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

# Load data

```{r}
#| label: load-data

demo_data <- read_excel(input_file, sheet = 1) %>%
  filter(Comments == "success")

str(demo_data)

pet_data <- read_excel(input_pet, sheet = 1) %>%
  filter(Comments == "success") %>%
  select(ID1, Visit, CAVTOT, TLG) %>%
  mutate(
    CAVTOT = log10(1 + CAVTOT),
    TLG    = log10(1 + TLG)
  )

head(pet_data)
dim(pet_data)
```

# Merge data sets

```{r}
#| label: merge-data

all_data <- demo_data %>%
  left_join(pet_data, by = "ID1") %>%
  select(ID1, Visit, Sex, Previous_TB, main_lineage, CAVTOT, TLG)

dim(all_data)
head(all_data)
```

# Curate data

```{r}
#| label: curate-data

test_data <- all_data %>%
  mutate(
    Visit        = as.numeric(Visit),
    CAVTOT       = as.numeric(CAVTOT),
    TLG          = as.numeric(TLG),
    Sex          = factor(Sex, levels = c("Female", "Male")),
    main_lineage = factor(main_lineage, levels = c("lineage2", "lineage4")),
    Previous_TB  = factor(
                     ifelse(Previous_TB == "0 episode", "No", "Yes"),
                     levels = c("No", "Yes")
                   )
  )

str(test_data)

cat("Visits present:", sort(unique(test_data$Visit)), "\n")
```

# Define colour schemes

```{r}
#| label: colour-schemes

sex_colors         <- c("Female" = "#E76BF3", "Male"    = "#00B0F6")
previous_tb_colors <- c("No"     = "#00BA38", "Yes"     = "#FF6600")
lineage_colors     <- c("lineage2" = "orange", "lineage4" = "royalblue")
```

# P-value formatting helper

```{r}
#| label: format-p

format_p <- function(p) {
  if (is.na(p)) return("p = NA")
  stars <- if (p < 0.001) "***" else if (p < 0.01) "**" else if (p < 0.05) "*" else "ns"
  label <- if (p < 0.001) "p < 0.001" else sprintf("p = %.3f", p)
  paste0(label, " ", stars)
}
```

# LOESS and LME plot function

```{r}
#| label: plot-function
#| message: false
#| warning: false

plot_loess_lme <- function(data, outcome, outcome_label,
                            group_var, group_label, group_colors,
                            save_path = NULL) {

  outcome_sym <- sym(outcome)
  group_sym   <- sym(group_var)

  # Prepare data
  dat <- data %>%
    select(ID1, Visit, all_of(c(outcome, group_var))) %>%
    drop_na() %>%
    mutate(
      Visit = as.numeric(Visit),
      ID1   = as.factor(ID1)
    )

  cat(sprintf(
    "\n%s ~ %s | N rows: %d | N participants: %d\n",
    outcome, group_var, nrow(dat), n_distinct(dat$ID1)
  ))

  # Fit LME: outcome ~ Visit * group_var + (1|ID1)
  # Visit is numeric — tests linear group x time interaction
  formula_str <- paste(outcome, "~ Visit *", group_var, "+ (1|ID1)")

  lme_annotation <- tryCatch({

    model     <- lmer(as.formula(formula_str), data = dat, REML = FALSE)
    anova_res <- Anova(model, type = 3)

    visit_p       <- anova_res["Visit",                     "Pr(>Chisq)"]
    group_p       <- anova_res[group_var,                   "Pr(>Chisq)"]
    interaction_p <- anova_res[paste0("Visit:", group_var), "Pr(>Chisq)"]

    paste0(
      "LME p-values\n",
      "Visit:        ", format_p(visit_p),       "\n",
      group_label, ": ", format_p(group_p),      "\n",
      "Interaction:  ", format_p(interaction_p)
    )

  }, error = function(e) {
    message("LME failed for ", group_var, " ~ ", outcome, ": ", e$message)
    "LME: model failed"
  })

  # Build plot
  p <- ggplot(dat, aes(
      x     = Visit,
      y     = !!outcome_sym,
      color = !!group_sym,
      fill  = !!group_sym,
      group = !!group_sym
    )) +
    geom_smooth(
      method    = "loess",
      se        = TRUE,
      span      = 0.75,
      linewidth = 1.2,
      alpha     = 0.2
    ) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.2, height = 0, alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x     = Inf, y = Inf,
      label = lme_annotation,
      hjust = 1.05, vjust = 1.1,
      size  = 3.5, color = "black"
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = group_colors, name = group_label) +
    scale_fill_manual(values  = group_colors, name = group_label) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = c(0, 4, 16, 24),
    ) +
    labs(
      title    = paste(group_label, "and treatment effect on", outcome_label),
      subtitle = "LOESS smoothing with 95% CI | LME statistical test",
      x        = "Visit (week)",
      y        = outcome_label
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      legend.position  = "top",
      plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold"),
      axis.title       = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black"),
      axis.text        = element_text(color = "black"),                   
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      panel.border     = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA)
    )

  print(p)

  if (!is.null(save_path)) {
    ggsave(
      filename = file.path(save_path,
                           paste0(group_var, "_", outcome, "_LOESS_LME.pdf")),
      plot     = p,
      width    = 5,
      height   = 5.5
    )
  }

  invisible(p)
}
```

# Define outcomes

```{r}
#| label: define-outcomes

outcomes <- list(
  CAVTOT = "Total cavity volume (log10 mL)",
  TLG    = "Total lesion glycolysis (log10 mL)"
)
```

# Sex

```{r}
#| label: fig-s13b
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 6
#| message: false
#| warning: false

for (out_name in names(outcomes)) {
  plot_loess_lme(
    data          = test_data,
    outcome       = out_name,
    outcome_label = outcomes[[out_name]],
    group_var     = "Sex",
    group_label   = "Sex",
    group_colors  = sex_colors,
    save_path     = output_main
  )
}
```
